question: Why does rev 6 print zero trades, and what can create +EV fills without last-window maker?

live_bot.tape_example: 16 markets, 5 fresh WS pairs, 11 stale, min ask_sum 1.001, max taker_net -0.001

findings.result: ATM YES+NO still quotes ask_sum ≥ 1.001 after fees. Lowering min_edge does not create a take. Same as universe_findings.json.

pair() required BOTH legs younger than 2s. Quiet books do not tick every 2s. The MM requote race is: one ask moves, the other sits. Rev 6 treated the sitting leg as stale and skipped the only moment a taker complement could exist.

At ~51s to expiry on 2026-08-26 14:59Z, 13/14 liquid 15M+1H windows had Up ask 0.001–0.01 and Down asks empty. Completing the $1 set is impossible: you can buy the dying side, not the winner. 0.97+0.01 only exists while BOTH asks are still posted. Empty winning book is not a bug in hunt(); taking the 0.001 side alone is directional and −EV if it expires at 0.

looks_empty(bestAsk≥0.99) is meant to drop 1.00/1.00 alts. True tails where YES is 0.99 (Up winning) were also dropped. Snapshot at 14:59Z had Gamma YES at 0.001 (Up losing), so this skip did not fire then, but it will drop the opposite tail.
Hunt set http_ok=not connected, so a token missing from the WS dump was never backfilled from CLOB REST.
6h replay: last-window maker 7 quotes, 0 two-sided fills, −$4.79. Re-enabling it would create 'trades' that lose money. Not used.

rev7.ws_hold: While the market socket is up, hunt with the last in-memory book of both legs (60s hold). A price_change on one leg uses the other leg's last snapshot.
rev7.http_gap_fill: If a token has no cache, or seconds_left≤120, fetch CLOB REST at most once per second per slug.
rev7.keep_0.99_tails: looks_empty only treats bestAsk≥1.0 as empty; bestAsk≥0.99 is kept when ≤180s remain.
rev7.still: maker_window=0, min_edge=0.02, FORCE_PAPER, no live, no paper reset

honest_expectation: Rev 7 makes the bot able to take a two-ask underround if it appears. It does not invent rest-state edge. Many expiries will still print zero fills because the winning ask is gone. Dashboard tape will show empty_ask_legs so that looks like a market fact, not a hung engine.
